digest.component_or_area: bridge fsck command and store auditing
propositions: Retire orphaned, duplicates, and stale output cells that depend on never-written SYNC events, removing them from structured output schema, CLI report, and all consumers.
Replace SYNC-based detection with a checkout-free ref-based two-stage unknown-event-type scan using git grep on refs/heads/tickets and git show for residual candidate verification.
Add store_integrity offline cell as a list of six specific finding kinds that validate forward and reverse binding consistency without Jira client or network access.
Map operational Git failures (missing executable, missing ref, malformed output, exit >=2, read/parse failure) to RebarError with returncode=2, causing CLI exit 2 and MCP command_failed envelope.
Preserve unknown_event_types as a non-gating upgrade warning and keep binding_drift informational, while new store_integrity findings gate with exit 1 for any inconsistency.
Retain live BRIDGE_ALERT event emission, reducer, and bridge-status compatibility entrypoint unchanged; scope out only the phantom SYNC machinery.
